body: Manish Mohnot (MD & CEO) on 2025-08-08 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "Current year, we stay confident that we would be at a PBT standalone in the range of 5% to 5.5%, more towards the higher side" Metric: Standalone PBT margin. Target: 5-5.5%. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: delivered. Evidence: 5.9% adjusted (4.9% reported). Note the floor was quietly lowered from 5.25% (May-25) to 5%, without comment.
